d: Component design and development Engineering organization team from GE gas power Engineering division, India is seeking a field Test Engineer to support all the regional customer field tests. Primary responsibilities are to support field testing in ME region at customer sites to cover instrumentation scope and test data collection. Also conducting material analysis as per the lab test processes and protocols and generating reports.
q: Bachelors in Mechanical, Electro-mechanical, Mechatronics, Electrical, Electronics, Manufacturing, Material, Instrumentation or/and Aerospace Engineering or a relevant field.
Minimum 2 years of experience in field or/ and lab testing, handling instrumentation or / and testing procedures.
Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% of the time to customer sites in GCC & globally.
The legal right to work in GCC without company sponsorship or time restriction.
Experience in handling laboratory analytical and data acquisition equipment
Good presentation and communication skills in Arabic
Eagerness to learn new technology, software tools & other relevant domains
Awareness of different type of sensors, working principles, usage scenarios.
Knowledge of lab quality certification and documentation
Working knowledge of test software such as Labview or any coding language such as C/C++ or python.
Knowledge of 5S & active AI engagement is a strong asset.
Strong oral and written communication skills. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs.
r: Responsible for execution of regional field tests and laboratory test support.

Responsible for executing field test at customer site by placing instrumentation, cable routing, data acquisition equipment interfacing, software operation and preparing traceable documentation to collect quality test data as per procedures.
Be a point of contact for the test procedure development of field samples, as per the regional/business needs and update processes as per international procedures.
Responsible for design and construction of lab test facilities, test rigs, instrumentation systems and operation of relevant test software.
Upgrade knowledge as needed time to time and come up with ideas of simplification
Perform periodic Calibrations and maintain the test equipment as per ISO procedures
Report the test results and daily site activities promptly to associated stakeholders
Work safely by adhering to all safety EHS guidelines and help in audits, maintain logs and close the open issues
